prompt:
You are a blind code reader in an empirical software-engineering study. Work only from the files in the current directory.

1. Read protocol.md first.
2. Read batch.md. It names 20 Java files by id, their path in their repository, and their local copy under files/.
3. For every file: read the whole file (use Read with offset and limit for files over 2000 lines, do not skip the tail). Identify the method with the highest cognitive complexity (the one with the most and deepest nested branches, loops and boolean chains) and name it. Then answer Q1, Q2, Q3 and Q4 from the protocol as true or false, each with one sentence of evidence from the file, and write a one-line note of the form "methodName: what it does". Do NOT derive or state the category; the mapping is applied later.
4. Blindness: do not try to read anything outside the current directory and do not try to find out anything about these classes beyond the file itself.
5. Answer with one entry per id of the batch, all 20 of them, in the required JSON form.

evidence.q4: The branches are capacity and ordering validation inside a loop, not a switch over kinds.

readings.note: appendEntries: appends new entries to the Raft log after checking capacity, term monotonicity and index continuity, persisting each

evidence.q1: onBindViewHolder sets listeners, loads images with Glide and triggers CheckIsSubscribedToSubreddit/SubredditSubscription calls, deciding which view setter or service to invoke; it computes no value.
evidence.q2: The class is a paged RecyclerView adapter for subreddit listings (view types, binding, footer network state), with subscription handling as part of the item's subscribe button.
evidence.q3: Nearly every line is a depth-2+ chain like ((DataViewHolder) holder).binding.subscribeImageViewItemSubredditListing.setVisibility(...) acting on the holder's views, driven by subredditData getters.
evidence.q4: The branches are instanceof/isMultiSelection/iconUrl/accountName guards with nested callbacks, not a switch over one controlling value.

readings.note: onBindViewHolder: binds a subreddit row (icon, name, subscriber count, click/checkbox behaviour) and wires the subscribe button to subscription calls

evidence.q1: isSafe checks the four knight-attack cells relative to (row, col) on the board array and returns whether a knight may be placed; knight() is the recursive backtracking over the same board.
evidence.q2: The class solves and prints the N-knights placement problem.
evidence.q3: It works only on its own boolean[][] board argument.
evidence.q4: The complexity is four independent bounds-then-occupied guards, not a case chain over one value.

readings.note: isSafe: returns whether placing a knight at (row, col) is unattacked by already-placed knights

evidence.q1: getOverlayOptions builds and returns the list of marker and polyline options from the route line: entrance/exit markers per step, start/end markers, and polylines stitched across steps with cycling colours.
evidence.q2: The class is an overlay manager that renders one IndoorRouteLine on the map; other methods are hooks for icons/colour and no-op click handlers.
evidence.q3: The getter chains (step.getEntrace().getLocation(), mRouteLine.getAllStep().indexOf(step)) read the route-line search-result data holder, from which the overlays are composed.
evidence.q4: The branching is null/size guards around loops over steps, no switch; the only switch is commented out.

readings.note: getOverlayOptions: converts the indoor route line into marker and polyline overlay options

evidence.q1: collectKafkaMetrics looks up version items and alive ZK nodes from services, then loops calling zookeeperMetricService.collectMetricsFromZookeeper(param) per metric and merges each returned result; it orchestrates service calls rather than computing from its own state.
evidence.q2: The class is one metric collector for ZooKeeper (collectKafkaMetrics plus collectorType).
evidence.q3: It reads DTO fields (elem.getStatus(), elem.getHost(), ret.getData().getMetrics(), clusterPhy.getZkProperties()) and service results, which are plain data carriers.
evidence.q4: The branching is skip-if-present and failed-result guards inside one loop with try/catch, no case table.

readings.note: collectKafkaMetrics: gathers ZooKeeper metrics for a cluster by invoking the metric service per version-control item and publishing the aggregate

evidence.q1: drawBubble renders the view's own state onto the canvas: GIF movie frame or faded preview bitmaps, map pin, unsupported mark, video icon, download-state overlay, size info panel and date/state panel with clock animation.
evidence.q2: The class is a message media bubble view: binds media from a message wireframe, measures itself and draws it (including download/upload state).
evidence.q3: Rendering uses the view's own fields (preview, desiredWidth, size, date, state); bindMedia reads TL model data holders via instanceof and getters.
evidence.q4: drawBubble's branching is many independent conditions (movie vs preview vs oldPreview, showMapPoint, isVideo, mode, isOut, state) with nested rendering blocks, not one short-case table.

readings.note: drawBubble: draws the media bubble contents (animation/preview, overlays, download state, size and time panels) and reports whether to keep animating

evidence.q1: startNode encodes a DOM node into SAX events, computing prefix mappings from xmlns attributes and namespace/local-name values before emitting startElement, comment, PI, CDATA or text callbacks.
evidence.q2: The class performs a pre-order DOM walk emitting SAX ContentHandler/LexicalHandler events.
evidence.q3: It reads DOM Node data (a syntax tree) and its own m_dh helper, and the emitted events are the class's own output.
evidence.q4: The complexity of startNode (and endNode) is a switch on node.getNodeType() with a short block per node kind; traverseFragment contributes only a small nested loop.

readings.note: startNode: dispatches on DOM node type to emit the corresponding SAX start events (prefix mappings, element, comment, PI, CDATA, text, entity)

evidence.q1: getFactory implements the ordered discovery procedure (cached factory, system property, META-INF service file, properties file, default class) and returns the LogFactory it resolves, caching it and applying property attributes.
evidence.q2: The abstract contract, static discovery/bootstrap, classloader helpers and diagnostic output all serve locating and creating the LogFactory implementation.
evidence.q3: It works with JDK ClassLoader, Properties and streams plus its own static state; no project-object getter chains.
evidence.q4: The branching is a sequence of fallback steps each wrapped in isDiagnosticsEnabled guards and try/catch, not a switch over one controlling value.

readings.note: getFactory: discovers, instantiates and caches the LogFactory implementation for the context classloader via system property, service file, properties file or default
